'''Ogun''', also known as '''Ogun the Destroyer''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] and [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]] imprisoned on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He broke out of the [[Belsavis prison]] during a break around [[3641 BBY]], but was [[Death/Legends|killed]] sometime after breaking out.<ref name="Tor" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ogun appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on the planet Belsavis. He is not directly involved in any quests, however he can be killed by characters of both factions or loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.<ref name="Tor" />
